title: Security Deposit Anniversary Interest Credit
content:
A held cash Security Deposit is credited on each anniversary of its fully secured date with simple interest for the year that the anniversary closes, booked as one interest credit dated that day whose period ends on the anniversary; instruments earn nothing and interest never earns interest.

**Condition on the recorded review date.** The interest for a completed year is credited only once the refund review date recorded on the deposit falls after the anniversary that closes that year.

Put the other way, while the refund review date recorded on the deposit falls on or before that anniversary, the year's interest credit is not booked.

| Refund review date recorded on the deposit, compared with the anniversary closing the year | Year's interest credit booked? |
|---|---|
| Later than the anniversary | Yes |
| The same day as the anniversary | No |
| Earlier than the anniversary | No |

## Booking the credit: `credit_deposit_interest_e2c6de3a`

**Capability.** The tool credits one period of simple interest to a cash Security Deposit. It books an interest credit on the deposit for the period ending on the stated date, dated today, and raises the cash and interest held on the deposit by the amount credited. The credit then appears among the deposit's transactions, and the held amount shown on the deposit includes it.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `deposit_id` | The deposit reference number of the Security Deposit being credited, as returned by the security-deposit lookup for the customer | Reference number |
| `interest_period_end` | The last day of the interest period this credit covers | YYYY-MM-DD, a calendar date with no time of day |
| `interest_amount` | The interest credited | USD with 2 decimal places, a positive amount already rounded to the cent |

**Return.** A one-line text receipt naming the new deposit transaction reference number, the deposit, the interest amount credited in USD with 2 decimal places, the period end date and the resulting held amount; the transaction reference number in the receipt confirms the credit was booked.

## Illustration (hypothetical deposit)

A deposit fully secured on 12 May 2025 reaches its first anniversary on 12 May 2026. The credit for that year is booked as one interest credit dated 12 May 2026 with `interest_period_end` 2026-05-12, provided the refund review date recorded on the deposit is later than 12 May 2026.
